Name: Pride Flag Butterflies
Author: NoraCharles
Description:
Add some Pride to Stardew Valley with Pride flag butterflies! This mod adds butterfly recolors for 31 Pride flags (32 if you count the alternate design for Polyamory Pride). The exact size & shape of each butterfly will vary depending on the flag, but there are 2 basic sizes for each variant:
[list]
[*]Large butterflies appear in Summer + year-round on Ginger Island (+ in Fall with a Butterfly Hutch)
[*]Small butterflies appear in Spring (+ in Winter with a Butterfly Hutch)
[/list]
This mod is configurable -- I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to easily change options while playing. The game's butterflies include 6 Spring variants + 6 Summer variants (also used in Fall) + 4 Island variants + 1 Winter butterfly. You can configure each of these variants:
[list]
[*]Choose a specific flag for each butterfly replacement, or...
[*]Choose the default "Random" option to see a variety of butterflies, or...
[*]Choose "Off" if you want to keep a particular vanilla butterfly
[/list]Refer to the [b]ConfigOptions.png[/b] image included in the mod folder (also shown above) to see all the Pride flag options as well as the vanilla butterflies that they will replace.

[b]Does not replace the rare butterflies[/b] that were added in Stardew 1.6!

[b]Does not change butterfly spawn rates, locations, etc.[/b] If you want to see more butterflies, I recommend the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11166]Better Butterfly Hutch[/url], which I used for the screenshots above so that I could show more butterflies in a single image.

Should be compatible with most mods unless they also replace the butterflies on the Critters tilesheet. But even those mods could still be compatible if they offer config options like this mod does -- for example, you can use this mod in combination with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1965]Elle's Town Animals[/url].

You may also like my mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24933]Pride Flag Shirts for Fashion Sense[/url]! A few shirts are shown in the screenshots above.


[b]MY OTHER MODS[/b]

Check out [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/NoraCharles/mods?gameId=1303]my other mods for Stardew Valley[/url], which include maps, animals, crops, furniture, clothing, and more!
All donation points earned by my mods go to [url=https://www.doctorswithoutborders.org/]Doctors Without Borders[/url].
